visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black coat and a black turtleneck, stands in front of a bright orange storefront door. She smiles warmly and holds up a peace sign toward the camera. Behind her, through the glass, shelves packed with colorful toys and a large blue statue are visible under bright indoor lights. (2) She turns and pushes the door open, entering the store. The camera follows her as she walks into a space densely filled with character merchandise, plushies, and festive banners hanging from the ceiling. (3) Close-up shot of yellow and white bunny plushies on a shelf. The woman reaches out her hand to touch a yellow bunny character with pink cheeks. The lighting is warm and highlights the soft texture of the toys. (4) The woman picks up a small blue plushie of Bubbles from The Powerpuff Girls and poses with it, smiling at the camera while standing in front of a grid of other character keychains. (5) She squats down next to a massive pink Lotso bear plushie on a low shelf, placing her hand against her face in a playful pose. The background is filled with various Pixar and Disney-themed boxes and displays. (6) She holds a pink Care Bear plushie in front of a shelf filled with colorful mugs and small collectibles. She is smiling broadly. (7) The woman stands next to a life-size statue of Sulley from Monsters Inc., which is holding an 'OPEN' sign. She gestures toward the statue with her palms up, showcasing its scale. (8) She sits at a brightly lit, purple and green Evangelion-themed arcade machine. She pulls a red lever and watches the digital screen, which displays fast-moving graphics. (9) She is seen at a counter area with Buzz Lightyear and Toy Story figures in a glass display case. She appears to be ordering a beverage. (10) The woman exits the store through the same orange door, carrying a white plastic bag containing her purchases. She looks back at the camera and smiles one last time. (11) A rapid closing montage features close-up shots of various plush toys, including Care Bears in multiple colors, Tom and Jerry figures, and Toy Story Aliens hanging on display racks.
